summary: Verified HLB flicker fix and MTV/Club Pachuca blob fix. All 7 brand-logo load with correct computed filters. Marquee GPU promotion active and animation running. No JS console errors (only expected 404s for text-fallback brands). Routes and mobile hamburger toggle work.
critical_code_review_comments: Expected 404s for /logos/bamx.*, catal.*, zoebisch.* generate console 'Failed to load resource' noise. Text fallback works but the initial attempt still logs 404 errors. Consider gating render on known-existing assets to keep console clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified assertions: filter='none' for HLB, MTV, Club Pachuca. filter='brightness(0) invert(1)' for Land Rover, BBVA, Tec de Monterrey, Tajín. All 7 imgs naturalWidth>0. .track willChange=transform, backfaceVisibility=hidden, transform matrix changes over 900ms confirming animation running. Routes /, /aviso-de-privacidad, /aviso-legal => 200. Mobile hamburger opens/closes at 375px. Text fallbacks render for BAMX, Catal 1.5°T, Zoebisch.
